search_text: published ZDI-13-242 ZDI-CAN-1647 Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center SOM sdFileDownload Servlet Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2013-10-16 CVE-2013-4826 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2013-4826 7.8 ['Hewlett-Packard'] ['Intelligent Management Center'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to obtain sensitive information on vulnerable installations of Hewlett-Packard Intelligent Management Center. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the sdFileDownload servlet. Authentication is not required to access this servlet, which allows any file readable by SYSTEM to be disclosed. By abusing this behavior an attacker can disclose administrative credentials and possibly leverage this situation to achieve remote code execution. Hewlett-Packard has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
